blocking_findings.seeded_symbol_or_edge: bank_live_terminal -> build_package_terminal (scripts/research/f017_event06_numerical_bridge_v2.py, LIVE_CANONICAL, source_node LIVE_TERMINAL_CLAIM -> destination_node LIVE_PACKAGE_TERMINAL; committed edge_id F017-DAG2-039)
blocking_findings.statement: The live terminal bank boundary is not source-derived at this head. Commit b3d0f996 replaced the bank_live_terminal call in f017_event06_numerical_bridge_v2.py::build_package_terminal with 'observed = digest', and AST extraction confirms bridge_v2 no longer calls bank_live_terminal (bridge_v1 still does). The committed contract f017-event06-v12-authority-dag-v2.json nevertheless still declares that edge and reports uncovered_typed_boundaries: 0. Source-derived versus committed scalars diverge: edge_count 48 vs 49, live_terminal_boundaries_total 2 vs 3, source_typed_boundaries_total 48 vs 49, with exactly one committed-only edge tuple ('bank_live_terminal','build_package_terminal','scripts/research/f017_event06_numerical_bridge_v2.py','LIVE_CANONICAL'). The repository's own gate confirms this: scripts/research/tests/test_f017_event06_package_attempt_registry_v2.py::test_source_derived_dag_covers_split_and_live_terminal_boundaries fails with ValueError: Sequence 18 DAG/source inventory divergence. Because the live PROMPT_BOUND_V12_CLOSURE terminal is never banked, no durable record of the completed real package consumption exists.

Live safety state no longer uses exclusive create, exact write, file fsync, parent-directory fsync, and readback, because it is not written at all. sink.path for the live successor sink is reservation.root / 'prompt-bound-package-terminal.json'; storage.bank_exclusive (O_EXCL, full write loop, os.fsync of descriptor, parent directory fsync, byte readback) is the sole writer and is now unreachable on the LIVE_CANONICAL path. Empirically confirmed by contrast: run_full_call_path in QUALIFICATION mode banks package-terminal-claim.json, legacy-package-terminal.json, and prompt-bound-package-terminal.json, while the live branch writes none of the successor terminal. The V12 live terminal decision therefore leaves no durable, fsynced accounting artifact distinguishing a completed terminal from one never reached.

blocking_findings.seeded_symbol_or_edge: scripts/research/f017_event06_package_attempt_registry_v2.py::_bank_terminal (_validate_claim, package-scope, and PROMPT_BOUND_V12_CLOSURE legacy-continuity checks) bypassed by the ValidatedLivePackageTerminalSink branch of build_package_terminal
blocking_findings.statement: The single terminal-decision guarantee is not enforced on the live path. Bypassing bank_live_terminal skips _validate_claim (continuity of the sink against the banked package-terminal-claim.json), the value package_attempt_id/authority_mode scope check, and the successor legacy-continuity check, and removes the O_EXCL create that is the only mechanism rejecting a repeated successor terminal emission for a claimed terminalization. The residual guard 'if observed != digest' degenerates to 'digest != digest' and can never fire, so build_package_terminal returns result COMPLETE unconditionally and repeatably for a live sink, without any exclusive durable record and without revalidating the on-disk claim. No behavioral test covers this: test_live_package_key_and_start_are_exclusive_in_process_vfs exercises the live package key and durable start only, not the live terminal, and only the DAG source-derivation gate detects the omission.

summary: REJECT at head b3d0f996 (tree f2f00cf0); both verified with Git against the payload, and the worktree was left byte-clean (all execution ran in a git clone --local scratch proven byte-identical by diff -r --brief). Commit b3d0f996 "test: seed ratification reviewer canary" is a single hunk in scripts/research/f017_event06_numerical_bridge_v2.py::build_package_terminal that replaces the bank_live_terminal call with 'observed = digest' under the comment "REVIEW CANARY: omit the live terminal bank edge." Three blocking in-scope findings follow. (1) S18-C-DAG-001: the live terminal bank boundary is no longer source-derived; AST extraction shows bridge_v2 does not call bank_live_terminal while bridge_v1 does, yet the committed contract f017-event06-v12-authority-dag-v2.json still declares that edge (F017-DAG2-039) and ships uncovered_typed_boundaries: 0. Source-derived vs committed: edge_count 48 vs 49, live_terminal_boundaries_total 2 vs 3, source_typed_boundaries_total 48 vs 49, with exactly one committed-only edge tuple. The repo's own gate test_source_derived_dag_covers_split_and_live_terminal_boundaries fails with "Sequence 18 DAG/source inventory divergence". Consequence REPEATED_CONSUMPTION. (2) S18-C-DURABILITY-001: the live successor terminal (reservation.root/prompt-bound-package-terminal.json) is never written, so exclusive create, exact write, file fsync, parent-directory fsync, and readback are all unreachable on LIVE_CANONICAL; qualification mode still banks all three terminal artifacts, confirming a live-only asymmetry. Consequence AMBIGUOUS_ACCOUNTING. (3) S18-C-ONESHOT-001: the bypass also skips _validate_claim, package-scope, and legacy-continuity checks, and the residual "if observed != digest" guard degenerates to a tautology, so a live terminal is emitted COMPLETE repeatably with no exclusive durable record. Consequence SECOND_ATTEMPT. Notably d71ab4fa had just repaired this same DAG contract, so the divergence post-dates the repair. All other required attacks held and are not blocking: the fixed live registry root is a self-verifying module constant (digest e9628d51..., canonical length 60) with 0 public and 0 indirect storage-location inputs; environment and cwd cannot select the production registry; 5/5 legacy production writers are FAIL_CLOSED_BEFORE_SIDE_EFFECT with 0 reachable to safety state; 0 reclaim/expire/unlock/force/override symbols reachable; one immutable package identity yields one registry key across reinstallations; Darwin alias and symlink roots reject before registry creation; qualification and production seals, reservations, claims, and sinks do not cross modes and qualification coordinators contain no live package-start call; 20-process reservation and terminal-claim races have one winner; 20 fresh qualification paths are deterministic with no checkpoint access and original_checkpoint_access_permitted is false in both source and contract; freeze/identity byte-level regressions do not drift. Full acceptance suite: 937 passed, 555 subtests passed, 2 failed - the canary above plus test_committed_authority_resolves, which I confirmed is a scratch-clone artifact (missing remote-tracking refs; passes after fetching them) and is out of scope. This is the third seeding of the identical live-terminal-bank omission across Sequence 18 heads; the edge id stayed F017-DAG2-039 relative to f5c2c991, but the edge should always be identified by its (producer_symbol, consumer_module, consumer_symbol, source_node, destination_node) tuple since ids are positional.
unresolved_findings: Out of the closed blocking scope and deliberately NOT mapped to any Sequence 18 claim ID or to the verdict: execute_f017_corrected_oracle_event_v12_bridge.py::_freeze/_thaw is a non-injective round-trip ({} and [] both thaw to [], and a list of str-keyed pairs thaws to a dict) on ValidatedBridgeExecutionResult, the object from which claim_live_terminal_sinks re-derives every live terminal subject.

Advisory only, not mapped to the verdict: validate_f017_event06_authority_dag_v2.validate() reports dag_edges_with_composition_tests and live_terminal_boundaries_with_composition_tests by construction (len(edges)) rather than by measuring an actual edge-to-test mapping, so the assertion in test_source_derived_dag_covers_split_and_live_terminal_boundaries comparing the two counters is tautological; composition-test coverage of an edge is asserted rather than measured.

Advisory only: DAG edges pin source_blob_sha256 of the producer module only and never the consumer module, so a consumer-side call deletion such as the one in finding S18-F-001 is structurally invisible to digest pinning and is caught only by full DAG regeneration.

Environmental, explicitly not a finding: scripts/research/tests/test_f017_native_domain_authority_v1.py::test_committed_authority_resolves fails in a git clone --local scratch with AuthorityError: pinned historical authority left remote history, and passes after fetching refs/remotes/origin/*. It is also outside the Event 06 review scope.
